cause.summary: lock2 calls mLockProfile.start just before an M sleeps on a contended runtime lock; start draws cheaprandn(gTrackingPeriod). Under Gomad cheaprand reads the process-wide seeded stream whenever the M holds the P. Whether a runtime lock outlasts the waiter's spin is host timing, so the seeded stream advanced by one at a host-timed moment.
cause.waiting_m: the M holding the P, on g0 in runtime.findRunnable, taking sched.lock (decision 7629 in the dumped divergent replay); wakep and mcommoninit are the other callers seen holding the P
cause.holding_m: an M without a P parking in runtime.stopm; exitsyscallNoP is the other P-less holder seen
cause.consequence: every later seeded draw moved by one. Type-assertion and interface-switch caches grow when a draw hits, so they grew at other call sites: at the same stream position 34346 the cluster-start goroutine (g 17) grew database/sql.(*driverConn).validateConnection's cache in a matching replay and database/sql.(*DB).execDC's in the divergent one, and fx.(*module).provide grew early. Goroutine 12 then grew fx.(*module).provide's cache from mask 1 instead of mask 0 at decision 11483, an allocation of another size, and two heap-span refills (span classes 8 and 11, then 10 and 11) swapped order. The replay diverged at choice ordinal 35573 (alternatives).
cause.allocating_goroutine: goroutine 12 at decision 11483, allocating a type-assertion cache in go.uber.org/fx.(*module).provide (runtime.typeAssert -> buildTypeAssertCache); the earlier misplaced cache growth is on goroutine 17 at decision 7630
cause.not_every_draw_diverges: a contended draw during startup (mcommoninit while the reserved Ms park) and a forced extra draw at the same point left the evidence unchanged: growth happens at the same stream positions one call earlier at a hot site
